{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1792983148133,"sessionID":"ses_e89e0fd16ffe7yX6Onh1czHxiW","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"edit","callID":"toolu_01SfCLW1nPm6MGCFApZrRdio","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"filePath":"/home/llmtest/evals/20261025-170040/unstructured_claude-haiku-5.5-oc-medium_omp_r2/unstructured/unstructured.cpp","oldString":"void runSimulation(World& world, const int n_iters) {\n    const size_t n_elems = world.elements_static.size();\n    \n    for (int iter = 0; iter < n_iters; ++iter) {\n        // Update all elements\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < n_elems; ++i) {\n            const ElementStatic& elem_static = world.elements_static[i];\n            const ElementDynamic& elem_dyn = world.elements_dynamic[i];\n            const Material& mat = world.materials[elem_static.material_idx];\n            \n            // Start with external flow\n            val_t total_flux = mat.external_flow;\n            \n            // Add flux from all connected elements\n            for (idx_t j = 0; j < elem_static.num_connections; ++j) {\n                const idx_t neighbor_idx = elem_static.connected_idx[j];\n                const ElementDynamic& neighbor_dyn = world.elements_dynamic[neighbor_idx];\n                total_flux += computeFlux(mat, elem_dyn, elem_static.connected_flux[j], neighbor_dyn);\n            }\n            \n            // Update element state\n            ElementDynamic& elem_write = world.elements_dynamic_swap[i];\n            elem_write.current_energy = elem_dyn.current_energy + total_flux;\n            elem_write.total_flux = elem_dyn.total_flux + std::abs(total_flux);\n        }\n        \n        // Swap buffers\n        std::swap(world.elements_dynamic, world.elements_dynamic_swap);\n    }\n}","newString":"void runSimulation(World& world, const int n_iters) {\n    const size_t n_elems = world.elements_static.size();\n    \n    // Raw views of the data. Buffers alternate by iteration parity, so the\n    // vector swap is performed once at the end instead of every iteration.\n    const ElementStatic* const statics = world.elements_static.data();\n    const Material* const materials = world.materials.data();\n    ElementDynamic* const buf[2] = {world.elements_dynamic.data(),\n                                    world.elements_dynamic_swap.data()};\n    \n    // One parallel region for all iterations: threads synchronize with the\n    // implicit barrier at the end of each worksharing loop (one per iteration).\n    #pragma omp parallel\n    {\n        for (int iter = 0; iter < n_iters; ++iter) {\n            const ElementDynamic* const src = buf[iter & 1];\n            ElementDynamic* const dst = buf[(iter & 1) ^ 1];\n            \n            // Update all elements. Each iteration reads only src and writes\n            // only its own dst slot, so the loop has no data races.\n            #pragma omp for schedule(static)\n            for (size_t i = 0; i < n_elems; ++i) {\n                const ElementStatic& elem_static = statics[i];\n                const ElementDynamic& elem_dyn = src[i];\n                const Material& mat = materials[elem_static.material_idx];\n                \n                // Start with external flow\n                val_t total_flux = mat.external_flow;\n                \n                // Add flux from all connected elements\n                for (idx_t j = 0; j < elem_static.num_connections; ++j) {\n                    const idx_t neighbor_idx = elem_static.connected_idx[j];\n                    const ElementDynamic& neighbor_dyn = src[neighbor_idx];\n                    total_flux += computeFlux(mat, elem_dyn, elem_static.connected_flux[j], neighbor_dyn);\n                }\n                \n                // Update element state\n                ElementDynamic& elem_write = dst[i];\n                elem_write.current_energy = elem_dyn.current_energy + total_flux;\n                elem_write.total_flux = elem_dyn.total_flux + std::abs(total_flux);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // An odd number of iterations leaves the latest state in the swap buffer;\n    // swap the vectors so world.elements_dynamic holds the final state.\n    if (n_iters > 0 && (n_iters & 1)) {\n        std::swap(world.elements_dynamic, world.elements_dynamic_swap);\n    }\n}"},"output":"Edit applied successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"diff":"Index: /home/llmtest/evals/20261025-170040/unstructured_claude-haiku-5.5-oc-medium_omp_r2/unstructured/unstructured.cpp\n===================================================================\n--- /home/llmtest/evals/20261025-170040/unstructured_claude-haiku-5.5-oc-medium_omp_r2/unstructured/unstructured.cpp\n+++ /home/llmtest/evals/20261025-170040/unstructured_claude-haiku-5.5-oc-medium_omp_r2/unstructured/unstructured.cpp\n@@ -120,32 +120,52 @@\n // Run simulation for n_iters iterations\n void runSimulation(World& world, const int n_iters) {\n     const size_t n_elems = world.elements_static.size();\n     \n-    for (int iter = 0;
